s.note: the Eternals living in ancient Babylon
s.how: Brush flatbreads with olive oil and sprinkle generously with za'atar. Grill over high heat until blistered and charred in spots. Spoon hummus into a bowl, make a well and scatter with pomegranate seeds and a drizzle of oil. Tear the bread and dip.

s.note: Sersi working at the Natural History Museum in London
s.how: Spread white bread with cream cheese and layer with thin cucumber slices. Hard boil 4 eggs, mash with mayonnaise and spread on more bread with mustard cress. Close the sandwiches, cut off the crusts and slice into neat fingers.

m.how: Toast and soak dried chillies, then blend with almonds, garlic, a little cinnamon and stock. Simmer the sauce 15 minutes and melt in 50g dark chocolate. Add 1kg chicken thighs and simmer 40 minutes until tender. Serve with long grain rice and tortillas.

w.how: Boil 2 whole oranges for an hour, cool and blend to a puree. Whisk 6 eggs with 220g sugar, then fold in the orange and 250g almond meal. Bake at 170C for 50 minutes. Glaze with warm honey and finish with gold sprinkles.

d.how: Stir 4 tbsp honey into 250ml warm water with the juice of 2 lemons and a few slices of ginger. Leave to infuse for 30 minutes, then chill. Pour over ice and top up with cold soda water. A drink older than most civilisations.
